input: Apply for a foreign language teaching assistant program

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Foreign Language Teaching Assistant Program
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a program that places them as a foreign language teaching assistant, likely abroad or at an institution.

questions.title: Which specific program are you applying to?
questions.description: Identify the exact program, such as Fulbright ETA, TAPIF, JET, or another teaching assistant program.

questions.title: Which country or region do you want to teach in?
questions.description: Determine the target country or region where the user wants to be placed as a teaching assistant.

questions.title: What language will you be teaching or assisting in?
questions.description: Clarify which foreign language the user intends to teach or assist with in the program.

questions.title: What is the application deadline you are working toward?
questions.description: Establish the specific deadline so the task plan can be scoped and prioritized correctly.

questions.title: Have you started any part of the application already?
questions.description: Find out the current progress, such as account creation, essays drafted, or documents gathered.

questions.title: Which application materials do you still need to prepare?
questions.description: Identify outstanding items such as personal statements, transcripts, recommendation letters, or language proficiency proof.

questions.title: Do you need anyone to review or endorse your application?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs recommenders, an institutional endorsement, or a faculty advisor involved in the process.
